camera_calibration.description: pixel_scale = session_median_shoulder_px / ref_shoulder_px; used for biomechanics (bat speed, foot plant, swing intensity baseline). Swing detection / shot clip boundaries use swing_pixel_scale (fixed 1.0) so the video shot classifier always sees the same framing as the legacy detector.

coaching_alerts.message: Head sliding off line on 3 shots (often the cover). Lowest score: #6 (47/100).
coaching_alerts.player_cue: Watch the seam onto the bat. Keep the head still — let the eyes track.
coaching_alerts.drill: 20 balls on a tee at off stump; restart if your head drifts sideways.

coaching_alerts.message: Uneven stance kept showing on 4 shots.
coaching_alerts.player_cue: Level shoulders, even weight, head quiet in the middle before you move.
coaching_alerts.drill: Eyes closed, settle, open — check shoulders in a mirror. Repeat 10 times.

coaching_alerts.message: Bat too tight to the body on 3 shots — often on the pull.
coaching_alerts.player_cue: On the pull, give the ball space — extend through the ball, don't roll across.
coaching_alerts.drill: 15 pulls with a slightly heavier bat; full extension through contact.

coaching_alerts.player_cue: Don't stretch; a slight bend in the arms keeps the face under control.
coaching_alerts.drill: Slower feeds; hit straight back to the feeder with the full face — 25 balls.

coaching_alerts.message: Front foot still moving at contact on 2 shots.
coaching_alerts.player_cue: Land the front foot, then swing — not both at the same time.
coaching_alerts.drill: Feeder says 'foot' then 'hit' with a clear gap between — 20 balls.
